purpose: Teach: 完備/部局/蓄え/出向い/改築/仮設/通さ/まずまず

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新社屋、設備、完備、徹底させろ、絶対、お客様、絶対、満足、いただける、本気で、絶対、頼んだ。
lines.en: The new building and its facilities need to be flawless. I need you to make absolutely certain our customers leave completely satisfied.
lines.style: Measured and authoritative. Weight on the critical demands. Lean forward slightly. Firm but not loud. No rush in the phrasing—this is settled fact being stated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各部局、新人配属、本気で、進めてまいります、絶対、人材活用、頑張ります、本気で、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with assigning new staff to each department. We'll make the most of our talent, and I'm genuinely grateful for your support.
lines.style: Respectful, methodical delivery. Slight bow in the voice. Even pace, each point discrete. Sincerity underneath—not performing gratitude, but meaning it. Feet planted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の蓄え、本気で、新事業に、絶対、活かせ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、これは、絶対だ。
lines.en: And our reserves—I want them channeled into this new venture. Make it work. That's an absolute.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Slight pause after the dash. No room for negotiation in the final sentence. Steady eye contact implied. This is non-negotiable expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様、出向いた、私の同僚、本気で、頑張ってくれました、絶対、感謝、しております、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Yes. Our key clients visited us, and my colleagues really stepped up for them. I'm truly grateful for their effort.
lines.style: Warm undertone, professional surface. Quick mention of the success—not dwelling. Pride in the team comes through without self-promotion. Genuine thanks, simply stated.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社の改築、本気で、進めろ、絶対、社員、皆、誇りに、思える社屋に、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Now, the headquarters renovation. I want it done properly and I want our staff to feel pride in this building. Make that happen.
lines.style: Slightly raised energy compared to earlier. This matters to him personally. Slower on 'pride'—let it land. Final sentence is quiet but firm. The building reflects them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仮設の事務所、本気で、急ぎ、対応してまいります、絶対、社員、本当に、お疲れ様、本気で、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll handle the temporary office setup quickly. I know our staff is exhausted, and I'm grateful for their patience through this.
lines.style: Efficient but warmed by acknowledgment of the team's fatigue. Not defensive—owning the inconvenience. Sincere exhaustion-recognition. Moving forward anyway, with respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 関係者に、絶対、お客様、通さないようにしろ、本気で、徹底だ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、これは。
lines.en: Keep external parties away from the clients. No exceptions. This needs to be airtight. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Drops to a lower register. Serious tone, almost dangerous in its quietness. This is protective, not paranoid. Steady delivery with emphasis on absolute control. Final phrase is personal—trust.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業、まずまずの、滑り出し、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、社長、本気で、頑張ってまいります、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The new venture is off to a solid start, and that's something to be grateful for. I'll keep driving this forward.
lines.style: Lighter than previous responses. Quiet satisfaction underneath. Not celebratory but genuinely pleased. Pace slightly quicker—momentum building. Closes with quiet confidence and commitment.
